opennyai_summary.7_July_2020__decision:
2. Issue notice to respondent returnable on 21st July, 2020.
All these offences are bailable.
Hence, I am inclined to grant interim protection to the applicants.
The applicants be released on interim bail on executing PR bond of Rs.15,000/-
each with one solvent surety each in the like amount, in the event of their arrest in connection with Crime No. 0053/2020 registered with Sadar Bazar Police Station,
Dist. Jalna, for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(1), 26(2)(IV), 27(E) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, on condition that they shall not tamper the prosecution evidence,
shall not interfere in the investigation and, shall remain present in the police station as and when called by the concerned Investigating Offcer.
opennyai_summary.facts:
3. The First Information Report was registered under Sections 188, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(1), 26(2)(IV), 27(E) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Subsequently, the investigation agency has added Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code, which is non-bailable.
It appears that all the packets of banned material have been seized and therefore, custodial interrogation of the applicants does not appear to be necessary.

Per Court :-
 1.
The applicant is seeking anticipatory bail in connection  with Crime No.53 of 2020 registered with Sadar Bazar Police  Station, District Jalna for the offences punishable under sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code and  under Section 26, 26(2)(iv), 27(2)(e), 59 of the Food Safety
and Standards Act
. Their application with similar prayer  bearing Criminal Bail Application No.134 of 2020 came to be  rejected by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Jalna.
2. Heard both the sides.
Rahul S/O. Bharat Jaiswal And Anr vs The State Of Maharashtra on 21 July, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2096668/
1  3.
By order dated 7th July, 2020, this Court (Coram :
::: Uploaded on - 22/07/2020 ::: Downloaded on - 23/07/2020 06:47:36 :
 2 921-ABA.342-20.odt  M.G.Sewlikar, J.) has granted interim bail to both the  applicants.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
It appears that applicant No.1 is the owner of  vehicle used in transporting the contraband Gutka and  applicant No.2 allegedly driving the said vehicle at the time of  raid.
Since all the packets of the contraband material came to  be seized at the time of effecting the raid, the custodial  interrogation of the applicants is not required.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Hence, following order.
ORDER 1.
The application is hereby allowed.
2. Interim anticipatory bail order dated 7th July, 2020 stands confirmed on the same terms and conditions.
3. Application is accordingly disposed off.
